integrity: The exact formula is proved independently from Schur orthogonality. Finite arithmetic checks are corroborative and are not used as an infinite proof. The exact second-moment identity itself is not claimed as new; novelty is the correction and consequence for arXiv:2602.10141v3.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the full-Haar second-moment normalization and its scale-dependent consequences only. It does not prove or disprove circular-Gaussian convergence after correct normalization, and it does not transfer the full-unitary formula to small submatrices of much larger Haar matrices.
title: Exact Haar-unitary permanent variance corrects the full-unitary normalization
